poc_summary:
POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- Goal: validate Dedicated pool sizing, achieve throughput and latency SLOs under representative traffic.
- SLO targets: P50 < 80ms for embedding lookups (64 tokens), P95 < 220ms for chat generation up to 180 tokens, P99 < 400ms during bursts.
- Throughput targets: sustained 2,500 embeddings/sec and 180 concurrent chat streams; burst capacity for 6,000 embeddings/sec for 5 minutes.
- Hardware planning: customer expects recommendation for reserved GPUs (proposal: 8x H100 or 16x A100 equivalent with mixed-precision quantization profiles).
- Tests to run: steady-state throughput test (24h), ramping soak (72h) to catch degradation, 1h spike runs to validate autoscaling/burst behavior, cold-start latency after model swap.
- Test harness: Redwood will run load generator from NA region and customer will replay anonymized production traces (sanitized) via secure S3 link.
- Metrics to capture: tokens/sec, requests/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU util, host mem, KV cache hit ratio, dropped requests, model fallbacks triggered.
- Acceptance: meet SLOs for 95% of test windows during 72h soak and provide regression dashboard; security questionnaire answered; legal signoff on SLA terms.
- Negotiation note: procurement pushing for uptime credits starting at 99.9%; AE to propose 99.95% with tiered credits and explicit maintenance windows.
